title: Joining the project in 1978; by 1979 no defense against remote viewing

tellings.quote: I got brought into the project in October of 78 by July of 79 we knew there was no defense against remote fuing

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a former Army remote viewer, says the military's remote viewing project at Fort Meade, Maryland, brought him in in October 1978. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe faraway places or things using only the mind. He says that by July 1979 the team knew "there was no defense against" it, which would mean no secret anywhere could be fully protected from such spying.
